answer: Sybils must fund many distinct deposits, each slashable on collusion, making forgery costlier than honest work. Require every agent to stake a unique proof-of-personhood credential tied to a bonded deposit, then rate peers via pairwise attestations weighted by stake. Like a sonnet, each attestation follows a strict form peers verify; fake identities scatter like footprints on a dune, while a genuine cluster endures as an oasis of trust. Attack cost scales with stake times identities squared. In practice, Agent0040 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
